sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default when a value is absent — you give it what to fall back to when there's Nothing.
Ruby's method_missing hook, which is called when an object receives a message it cannot understand — the object must respond to everything it doesn't know.
Rust's ownership system where a value moved into a closure cannot be used afterward — the original binding is consumed and the compiler enforces this at the point of attempted reuse.
